propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits 'Ambiguous prefix' diagnostic messages to stderr during post-close caused-by derivation when commit subjects contain bare 4-hex fragments matching multiple tickets

The caused-by derivation performs unbounded O(commits × tickets) work by re-resolving the bug_id on every commit without caching or quiet resolution, resulting in multi-minute hangs after the close has durably committed

Four changes eliminate the hang and noise: pass quiet=True at all scanner call sites, hoist bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop, memoize ref-to-resolution mappings, and short-circuit on hex-quad shape before filesystem access
Reference resolution semantics are unchanged: all supported id forms (full canonical, 8-hex two-quad prefix, alias, Jira, unambiguous bare 4-hex) continue to resolve identically
Documentation must stop advertising bare 4-digit (single-quad) references as a supported form, listing only alias, 8-digit two-quad prefix, full canonical id, and Jira/bridge ids as preferred
